summary: Reject research routes that depend on discarded rocket-silo construction recipe products.
details: Rocket-silo crafting advances rocket construction and does not produce the recipe's declared items or fluids. The shared acquisition solver no longer accepts a silo as an ordinary output-producing machine.

An independently obtainable ordinary assembler can still supply the same recipe/category. Controlled recipe, item-acquisition and downstream-science checks reproduce the old false admission, preserve that real alternative, and reject stale results after its removal.

The A04 satellite launch-product acquisition route remains unfinished. This correction grants no new launch, native output, catalogue or save qualification and does not alter the published 4.2.1 packages.
